description: Explain a five-field cron expression in plain English, list the next runs in UTC, and warn about the cases Cloudflare Workers, GitHub Actions and crontab handle differently (nicknames, six fields, day-of-month plus day-of-week, sub-5-minute intervals, day 31).

count.description: How many next runs to list, 1 to 20, default 5

from.description: ISO date to compute next runs from, default now

name: explain_cron
